sample_unit: de-identified stroke cases (Stage 2b); also 100 questions in Stage 1 and 20 guideline-derived questions in Stage 2a

links.outcome: Repeated-generation score stability across three generations per question/case between models
links.effect: Repeated-generation score stability did not differ significantly between ChatGPT-o3 and DeepSeek.
links.quote: Repeated-generation score stability did not differ significantly between models.

links.outcome: Clinician-rated correctness, completeness, safety of LLM stroke Q&A and rehabilitation plans, and accuracy on 100 questions
links.effect: Stage 1 accuracy: DeepSeek 91%, ChatGPT-o3 90%, Gemini 85%, ChatGPT-4o 83%. ChatGPT-o3 outperformed DeepSeek on plan generation across all five domains; Q&A comparable.
links.quote: In Stage 1, DeepSeek achieved the highest accuracy (91%), followed by ChatGPT-o3 (90%), Gemini (85%), and ChatGPT-4o (83%).

links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of candidate LLMs on the same questions and cases
links.effect: Four LLMs compared on 100 questions; top two compared on Q&A with no significant differences and on 60 cases where ChatGPT-o3 outperformed DeepSeek across all five domains.
links.quote: In Stage 2b, ChatGPT-o3 significantly outperformed DeepSeek across correctness, completeness, readability, helpfulness, and safety in the GEE analysis.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM stroke Q&A responses (Chinese LDU-TGP and English Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: ChatGPT-o3 produced Q&A responses with higher recommended reading age and English FK Grade Level than DeepSeek; Chinese difference not significant after correction.
links.quote: ChatGPT-o3 generated clinical Q&A responses with a higher recommended reading age and English Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, whereas the difference in Chinese Reading Difficulty Score did not remain significant after correction.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, safety, readability, and consistency of LLMs on stroke guideline Q&A and retrospective rehabilitation plan generation without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
